data.summary: Implemented schema-2 ext4 used-block compact capture with 64 MiB buffer, read-only WSL source, omitted swap metadata, guarded minimum target capacity, and re-armed two-boot expansion. All 20 Python regression scripts, targeted Ruff/compile, real WSL e2image/fsck/resize wrapper, and loop-device expansion tests pass. Physical SSD capture/restore and unattended cabinet boots remain.
